title: Which Knight?
setup: The white king has been dragged to h3, and both of your knights can jump to g5 with check. Only one of them wins.
hint: The king has exactly one bolt-hole. Both knight jumps look identical, and only one of them keeps that hole covered.
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight on f3 covers h4, the one square the white king could run to, so the other knight goes.

{{Neg5+}} leaves the king a single reply, {{Kg4}}, and {{h5+}} keeps driving it toward your pieces until it is mated a few moves later. Send the wrong one, {{Nfg5+}}, and the king slips out to {{Kh4}}.

When two identical pieces can reach one square, the scoresheet names the file they came from. Here that letter separates a forced mate from a merely good position.
